purposeStatement: Horizontal single-select group of 2-4 equal-width segments for mutually exclusive option/view switching; NOT for route navigation, binary on/off (use Switch), multi-select, or triggering actions (use Button).

antiPatterns.pattern: A row of styled <button>/<Button> elements toggling a 'selected' class to fake a segmented control
antiPatterns.reason: Re-invents an existing registered component with ad-hoc selected styling and inconsistent radius/spacing.

antiPatterns.pattern: Using two <Switch> or several <Badge> elements to express a single mutually-exclusive choice
antiPatterns.reason: Wrong semantics — these do not enforce single-selection and drift from the canonical control shape.
